name: PC-Diagnose
description: PowerShell-based diagnostics tool for normal Windows desktop PCs.

tools.name: PCDiagLite
tools.description: Collects a lightweight desktop PC diagnostics package with grouped local analysis and clickable Event Viewer details.

parameters.name: DaysBack
parameters.description: Event analysis range in days. 0 means all available entries.

parameters.name: PrivacyMode
parameters.description: Masks typical sensitive values before ZIP creation.

tools.name: NetzwerkDiagnose
tools.description: Creates a detailed Windows network diagnostics HTML report for LAN, DNS, routing, Wi-Fi, SMB, latency, and optional speed tests.

parameters.name: OutputPath
parameters.description: Output folder for the HTML report.

parameters.name: OpenReport
parameters.description: Open the HTML report after completion.

tools.name: NTLiteChecker
tools.description: Compares NTLite preset and Windows unattended XML files from a ZIP with the current Windows installation.

parameters.name: InputZip
parameters.description: ZIP containing NTLite presets, unattended XML files, and optional supporting logs. A file picker opens when omitted.

parameters.name: OutputRoot
parameters.description: Output folder for the verification report.
